title: Road black spots: published crash counts versus rectification status
summary: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024 reports about 1.77 lakh road deaths. Parliament and PIB replies also publish National Highway black-spot identified and long-term rectification totals. Check year-wise crash and fatality figures against successive black-spot identified-versus-rectified counts, and whether official status categories add up without gaps.
jurisdiction: Union of India — National Highways and all-India crash reporting
authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH); Transport Research Wing
scope: Year-wise all-India road accident, fatality and injury totals from MoRTH Road Accidents in India and successive Lok Sabha annexures
Official National Highway black-spot identified totals versus temporary and permanent rectification counts in PIB and Parliamentary replies
Arithmetic consistency of black-spot status categories across successive Union statements
Where published, state-wise fatality annexures versus stated black-spot rectification progress
out_of_scope: Naming drivers, victims, or private contractors
statutory_anchors: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 — Section 215 (National Road Safety Council)
MoRTH black-spot identification criteria as stated in Union replies (accidents involving fatalities and grievous injuries)
